name: network_log_summary
description: Parse Apache/Nginx access, Squid access and common key/value firewall logs into a complete normalised TSV plus parse errors and aggregate counts. Every source line is preserved in one of the two output files.

path.description: A plain-text or gzip-compressed network log

out_dir.description: An empty directory under work/ for normalized.tsv and unparsed.tsv

top.description: Aggregate rows returned per category (default 20); complete rows remain in normalized.tsv
